cohort: 940 women from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) study
finding: 25OHD inadequacy was prevalent in pregnant Singaporean women, particularly among Malay and Indian women, and was associated with higher fasting glucose concentrations in Malay women and an increased risk of emergency cesarean section in Chinese and Indian women.
mod_finding: A trend between 25OHD inadequacy and a higher likelihood of emergency cesarean section was observed.
